forward_governance_requirements.title: Strategy state identity and safety
forward_governance_requirements.requirement: Every strategy-state record used by a proposal shall carry immutable strategy, configuration, model, feature-schema, and state-version identities. Strategy state is evidence only and cannot grant execution authority. Missing or unverifiable identity fails closed.

forward_governance_requirements.title: Strategy-state transitions
forward_governance_requirements.requirement: Strategy-state transitions shall be explicit, attributable, deterministic for identical inputs, and monotonic in version. Stale, conflicting, invalid, or superseded state shall not silently become current. Restart shall not reactivate state without current validation.

forward_governance_requirements.title: Model integrity and compatibility
forward_governance_requirements.requirement: Every decision using model output shall bind exact model/artifact, configuration, feature-schema, preprocessing, universe, and material dependency identities. Incompatible, stale, missing, unknown, or silently substituted model evidence shall be rejected.

forward_governance_requirements.title: Signal lineage, freshness and expiry
forward_governance_requirements.requirement: A signal used as decision evidence shall carry attributable source/data lineage and observation time. Evaluation shall use injected UTC time and an explicit applicable freshness/expiry policy. Expired, stale, superseded, invalid, or temporally ambiguous signal evidence shall remain non-authoritative and result in NO-TRADE or restriction.

forward_governance_requirements.title: Decision authority
forward_governance_requirements.requirement: Proposals, model outputs, signals, approvals, and historical decisions remain non-executable evidence. Increased exposure requires current, scoped, matching authorization. UNKNOWN, NO-TRADE, expired, invalidated, mismatched, or stale evidence cannot acquire authority.

forward_governance_requirements.title: Recovery and replay safety
forward_governance_requirements.requirement: Replay and forensic reconstruction remain observational and cannot create financial effects. Recovered proposals, decisions, approvals, and historical evidence cannot regain current authority through restart, restoration, retry, or replay. Later resumption requires current validation against applicable evidence, configuration, restrictions, and authorization.

forward_governance_requirements.title: Fail-closed uncertainty
forward_governance_requirements.requirement: Across strategy state, model evidence, signal evidence, and recovery evidence, missing, stale, invalid, conflicting, incompatible, or unverifiable input must never be interpreted as current or authorized. The result must preserve UNKNOWN, NO-TRADE, or an appropriately restrictive operational state.

forward_governance_requirements.title: Causal evidence
forward_governance_requirements.requirement: State, model, signal, proposal, decision, invalidation, and recovery records shall preserve sufficient immutable identity, correlation, causation, schema/version, and UTC-time evidence to distinguish current from historical evidence. Logs and metrics remain observational and cannot replace canonical evidence.
